pcs.pc_description: identify the work requirements from the instructions received from supervisor and interpreting information from previous day/shift logbook
use personal protective equipment appropriate for work activities
select appropriate type of auxiliary equipment for work activities
inspect and assess site conditions to determine if scaling is required and take action according to site requirements
place visible orientation marks to drill plan according to site procedures

modules.module_title: Inspect and prepare the DTH/LH drill rig for operation

pcs.pc_description: check various controls, gauges, warning lamp, Roll-Over Protection Structure (ROPS) and Falling Object Protective Structure (FOPS), hydraulic boom, front and rear mounted stingers and other safety devices of the DTH/LH drill rig for proper functioning and any defect
perform visual checks to detect cracks, wear and tear or any damage that could result in structural weakness
check coolant level and oil levels of engine, differential, hydraulic tank etc. and top up/refill as required
check electrolyte level, terminals, seating arrangements of the battery and take corrective actions as per SOP, if required
check functioning of fire extinguishers, automatically operated fire suppression system and devices including fire detection system in the drill rig
check under carriage and superstructure of the drill rig
apply grease to all greasing pins and pivot points of the drill rig
keep footplates and steps clean and free from mud, dirt and oil
ensure that drilling site is clear of other mine workers to avoid any accidents
maintain the operation and maintenance logbook to detail all activities conducted before starting the drill rig
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of his/her role

modules.module_title: Move and position the DTH/LH drill rig at site

pcs.pc_description: start the engine using the push-button switch and key switch together
follow safety practices such as wear safety belt & helmet, no use of phones etc. while driving
raise drill guide to 1.5m above ground level and make it horizontal to prevent any damage in transit
look out for people working, stationary objects and hazards such as overhead pipes, power lines, etc. during driving
follow the safety signs and locally developed signals during driving
move, position and stabilise the drill rig at site according to ground conditions
connect auxiliary devices and computer control system with the drill rig
align drill rod with the orientation marks
feed the drilling parameters i.e. angle of drill rod, drilling speed etc. in the computer control system as per the requirement and drill plan
operate the DTH/LH drill rig safely within working environment limitations and face/ground conditions
drills holes in the surface as per the drill plan
realign equipment according to drill design and ground conditions
monitor the ground conditions and adjust drilling techniques and components to maintain drilling operations
install collar pipes according to site procedures
remove drill cuttings and sludge to ensure drill hole remains clean
complete all required documentation clearly, concisely and mark misdirected holes according to site procedures
carry out shutdown procedures and de-rig equipment according to manufacturer specifications and site requirements
clear site and remove auxiliary services according to site requirements
drive back the drill rig and park the vehicle on firm, level ground; with handbrake applied and drive & controls disengaged after completion of work
complete all required documentation clearly, concisely and on time

read maintenance schedule and checklist and plan the time and schedule for conducting the maintenance

modules.module_title: Repair and maintain the DTH/LH drill rig

pcs.pc_description: follow safety practices during maintenance activities as per organisational SOP
perform basic health check-up of DTH/LH drill rig as specified in the maintenance checklist
check and maintain the tyre rims, air pressure, wheel nuts and treads
check battery levels and condition of the terminals and carrying out minor adjustments if required
replace/change the spare parts and consumables of the DTH/LH drill rig as per the schedule
replenish coolants, lubricants and fluids as per SOP
clean air filter dust bowls, footplates, pedals and steps and ensure that they are free from mud, or dirt

check the condition of DTH/LH drill rig parts i.e. hydraulic boom, front and rear mounted stingers, bearings, shafts, battery systems, motors, wiring harness and connectors and other similar parts etc. to test its working status and expected conditions
check the instrument panel and control gauge to identify out of range readings to find the defect/cause of failure

check the systems of the DTH/LH drill rig to find out root cause of the problems like any leakage, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, etc. and discuss the same with senior if required
ensure that no diagnosis on the machine is performed when it is running or is still hot
ensure proper lock out and tag out of machine to avoid any untoward incident triggered due to unknowingly operation of machine / system under maintenance
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
conduct trials of the DTH/LH drill rig and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
fill the daily, weekly and monthly maintenance/defect sheets as per the format lay down by the organization
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities

modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: undertake "The Take-5 (Personal Risk Assessment)" before commencement of any work
comply with safety, health and security- related regulations/guidelines at the mine e.g. follow Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for material handling in underground (U/G) mine
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at a worksite when required
check that roof supporting is as per Systematic Support Plan (SSP) and approved Systematic Support Rules (SSR) while undertaking work in an area
take precaution against occupational health hazards (like dust, water, mine gases etc.) due to U/G working environment
use self-rescue apparatus, appropriately when required
follow appropriate emergency response procedure during emergency such as fire, water inrush, fall of ground etc.
follow precautions against U/G electrical appliances
follow appropriate Standard Operating Procedure while working near any isolated and sealed off area of the mine
follow appropriate safety practices while traveling on U/G haul roads, incase of post blast fumes and misfire
follow the manufacturer’s instructions for care and safe operation of mine machinery and equipment
identify the working ventilation district from line diagram of ventilation circuit to direct air to the working face
follow Safety Management Plan (SMP) and Emergency Management Plan (EMP)
follow gas detecting alarm signal on leakage of inflammable gases and laid out procedure to ensure safety
follow process for reporting any unsafe act/condition in work area to the concerned person
use underground mine communication system
ensure positive isolation near the work place if applicable
use appropriate PPE as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify six directional hazards at workplace and take decisions accordingly
identify the environmental impact of mining related operations and follow steps to reduce those impact
follow the mineral conservation practices in U/G mining operations to achieve optimum ore or mineral recovery
ensure that the stowing practices produce minimum disturbance to the surface
ensure that the subgrade ore is carried out to surface and stacked separately at the earmarked place
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
follow the "5-S" practice at work site like cleaning oil from ground (to avoid soil from getting damaged), etc.
